title: Numerical methods and scientific libraries
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local faster-whisper small.en machine transcription; not publisher captions or verified audio.
source_uncertainties: Historical OpenFOAM and GPU/Xeon Phi plots were inspected as lecture evidence, not reproduced or normalized into a matched-error comparison.
The NUMA primary paper was opened; its reported 32,768-core DG result is tied to its experiments.
No audio verification was performed; garbled transcript words and numbers are not attributed as spoken errors.
PETSc, SciPy, pyFFTW and CuPy Python bindings were unavailable; no such execution is claimed. NumPy FFT is explicitly distinct from FFTW.
System BLAS configuration is recorded; no optimized BLAS vendor or observed thread count is inferred solely from environment variables.

Initial manual Thrust attempt failed because nvcc was outside launcher PATH; a second hit the 25-second compile timeout. Retained successful third attempt used a 60-second compile budget and a 20-second runtime bound; compilation took about 25 seconds.
No native cuBLAS or cuFFT routine was executed; shared-library availability is inventory evidence only.
NUMA PDF abstract was opened successfully and supports the cited scaling statement; later attempts to reopen full sections timed out, so no additional detailed claim relies on those sections.
